commits.subject: Faithfully flat descent of invertible modules, landed as pure algebra (Wave-3 lane L5, the honest algebraic core of Picard separatedness (C1) and rigidified effectivity (C2)): descent data in Sweedler-coring/comodule form (coaction M -> B tensor_A M with counit + coassociativity; dictionary to the classical B tensor B cocycle iso recorded), the descended A-module as the coaction equalizer, and the comparison B tensor_A M_0 -> M an isomorphism — effectivity needs only FLATNESS of A -> B (counit + coassoc make the augmented complex contractible after base change; a strengthening over the textbook statement), faithfulness entering only for Amitsur exactness in degrees <= 1, the unit N = (B tensor N)_0, and uniqueness of descent. Property descent along faithfully flat maps: finite presentation (new to the tree; mathlib only had the algebra form), finite projectivity, and INVERTIBILITY (via dual-commutes-with-base-change for finite projectives, retract argument) — so the descended module of an invertible module is invertible (Module.DescentDatum.invertible_descended, the lane deliverable). Confirmed absent from mathlib v4.31: any Amitsur complex, any effective descent of modules. Unit-cocycle recipe for the Picard consumers documented (toSpanSingleton coaction from a unit of B tensor B; cocycle condition = coassoc).
